_说明: 《霓虹巨兽》广播台词：霓湾市应急广播 + 防卫指挥官拿扩音器朝巨兽喊话（真人指挥官远程喊话，不是 AI 播报）。措辞按真实应急广播 / 警方喊话 / 无线电通话的习惯：先呼叫对象、短句、命令式、关键内容重复一遍。键 = 触发点；生成：Tools/voice_gen.py

start.zh: 霓湾市应急广播，现在播发紧急通告。巨型不明生物已进入市区，全市一级戒备。巨兽，你听好了：立即离开霓湾，否则我方将实施核打击。重复一遍，立即离开！
start.en: This is the Neon Bay Emergency Broadcast. A giant unidentified creature has entered the city. All districts are on full alert. Creature, listen up: leave Neon Bay now, or we will authorize a nuclear strike. I say again, leave now!

leave1.zh: 前方巨兽请注意！你已进入管制区，立即停止破坏，原路退回海湾！
leave1.en: Attention, creature! You are in a restricted zone. Cease destruction and return to the bay at once!

leave2.zh: 警告！把那栋楼放下！马上撤出城区！
leave2.en: Warning! Put that building down! Withdraw from the city, now!

leave3.zh: 这里是防卫指挥部。巨兽，这是最后一次喊话：立即离开，否则后果自负！
leave3.en: This is Defense Command. Creature, this is your last warning: leave immediately, or face the consequences!

reinforce.zh: 指挥部通报：通缉等级上调，增援部队已经出动。
reinforce.en: Command to all units: threat level raised. Reinforcements are rolling out.

tower.zh: 紧急通报！封印塔失守！各单位注意，集中火力，给我拦住它！
tower.en: Emergency! A seal tower is down! All units, concentrate fire and hold it back!

weak.zh: 各单位注意，目标已经受伤。不要停火，继续压制！
weak.en: All units, the target is wounded. Do not let up. Keep firing!

nuke60.zh: 全城广播：核打击程序已启动，倒计时六十秒。这是最后通牒。
nuke60.en: Citywide alert: nuclear strike sequence initiated. Sixty seconds. This is your final ultimatum.

nuke10.en: Ten seconds! All units, clear the area!

nuke_launch.zh: 核弹已发射。重复，核弹已发射！
nuke_launch.en: Missile away. I say again, missile away!

down.zh: 指挥部通报，目标已停止活动。解除警报。
down.en: Command to all units: the target is down. Stand down the alert.

win.zh: 指挥部……封印塔全部失守……我们拦不住它。全员撤离，重复，全员撤离！
win.en: Command... all seal towers are lost... we can't stop it. All personnel, evacuate. I say again, evacuate!
